card.name: Drug interactions that lower drug exposure
card.fires_on: Words in interaction statements where one drug (often a bile acid binder like cholestyramine or colesevelam, or an inducer) reduces another drug's levels. It fires on the verb, the article after it, or inside the affected drug's name.

modes.label: Reduction verbs and following words
modes.description: Words like decreased, reduces, decrease, and the word right after them in an exposure-lowering statement.
modes.example: Concomitant cholestyramine administration decreased<< the>> mean AUC of total ezetim

modes.label: Inside the affected drug's name
modes.description: Middle pieces of a drug name that is the subject of lowered exposure or interaction.
modes.example: maximum plasma concentration and total exposure to glime<<pir>>ide is reduced.
